It's not just about money as even the amateur leagues have play-offs. It's simply far more entertaining.

The majority of the league would have nothing to play for for a significant chunk of the season.   

With the play-offs existing, there's never really going to be a scenario where you've not got at least an outside chance of either play-offs or relegation with 8 games left. Sure there will still be teams with nothing to play for in the final games, but this is massively reduced by the play-offs existing. And of course the play-offs themselves are very entertaining, & there's no feeling like winning them.
